scope: Independent inspection of selected primary grammatical evidence during audit reconciliation. Not a full source-book certification or learner/key acceptance.
inspection_method: Every listed page was actually opened through view_image and read, not merely rendered or hashed.

checks.finding: Finite subject/predicate nominatives and same-case apposition; the explicit hīe sume example supports II.12.10, whose printed hint is151. Do not silently replace that target with a genitive partitive.
Direct-address form is nominative; surrounding genitive taxonomy is not thereby entirely assigned.
Accusative direct object and accusative subject of infinitive; the perception example is specifically geseah ... sumne fiscere gān.

Temporal on+accusative is explicitly an exception to a simple rest/motion generalization. Object-predicate accusatives include God hine geworhte ... . No general instrumental system is assigned by reading adjacent174.
Distinguishes noun/content clauses from purposive adverbial ðæt; independent commands/wishes and hypothetical contexts are separate uses.

Object clauses after knowing/affirmation/command/desire; examples include embedded questions. The indicative note explicitly marks certainty. This supports contextual mood scope, not an exceptionless subjunctive or backshift algorithm.
Adverbial and relative mood uses must not become new productive scope merely from adjacency; distinguish imperative morphology from nonfinite infinitive.
Uninflected infinitive after modal and accusative+infinitive frames, with explicit gesēah example; forms/functions overlap with inflected infinitive, so no universal English-to-OE replacement rule.
Actual Orosius text provides reported content and embedded wh/whether clauses; its dialect/spelling does not replace selected Cook forms.
Explicit note: mixed-gender reference generally uses neuter. Supports the bounded nonhuman coordinated predicate needed for II.9.6; lexical genders still need the source audit.

pre_contract_edits.finding: Attributive article agreement should not be described as its own independent argument role.
pre_contract_edits.resolution: Revised prompt explicitly distinguishes agreement with a noun from a role within the relative clause; verified in actual task-seed.json.

pre_contract_edits.finding: Simple-present birð does not itself assert completed aspect.
pre_contract_edits.resolution: Unsupported completed-action demand removed; actual prompt now asks for carrying action.
